skill.needleStorm.summary: Fires a fast bolt at the nearest enemy. Walls stop it.
skill.needleStorm.awakening: +{needles} needles in a fan, damage +{damage}%, pierce {pierce}. Each hit sends a shard into a nearby enemy for {shard}% damage.
skill.fanKnives.summary: Scatters thin knives in a fan ahead.
skill.fanKnives.awakening: +{knives} knives. They fly back and cut the enemies behind you too.
skill.chainSpark.summary: Strikes a bolt that leaps between enemies.
skill.chainSpark.awakening: +{jumps} jumps, damage +{damage}%. The last jump explodes and stuns for {stun} s.
skill.frostLine.summary: Draws a slowing cut toward the nearest enemy.
skill.frostLine.awakening: Width +{width}. The frost the cut leaves roots enemies for {root} s.
skill.orbitScythes.summary: Blades circling you keep grinding the enemies that come close.
skill.orbitScythes.awakening: Adds {blades} outer blades circling the other way.
skill.boneMortar.summary: Drops a heavy blast where enemies crowd the most.
skill.boneMortar.awakening: Blast radius +{radius}, damage +{damage}%. A {aftershock}% shockwave bursts once more at the centre.
skill.railSpear.summary: Fires a piercing line across the screen.
skill.railSpear.awakening: Width +{width}, damage +{damage}%. Fissures burst for {fissure}% along the rail's path.
skill.mirrorClone.summary: Afterimages on either side fire with you.
skill.mirrorClone.awakening: The clones fire +{shots} aimed shots, pierce +{pierce}. With Black Rail, they copy a rail {chance}% of the time for {railDamage}% damage.
skill.voidMine.summary: Leaves a mine field underfoot that pulls enemies in.
skill.voidMine.awakening: Radius +{radius}, duration +{duration}s. The field ends in an executing blast.
skill.blackSun.summary: Opens a pulling gravity well where enemies crowd.
skill.blackSun.awakening: Radius +{radius}, duration +{duration}s. Its collapse deals damage by max health and a long slow.
skill.ironFrame.awakening: Defence +{defense}, max health +{maxHp}. A hit raises a shield for {shield} s.
skill.magnetSigil.summary: Pulls in XP and coins from farther away.
skill.magnetSigil.awakening: Pickup range +{magnet}, coins +{coins}%. Every {pulse} s it pulls in the rewards on the map.
skill.paperWard.summary: Raises defence and the invulnerability after a hit.
skill.paperWard.awakening: Defence +{defense}. A hit bursts paper that pushes back enemies within {radius}.
skill.recoveryThread.summary: Raises health regeneration and pickup range.
skill.recoveryThread.awakening: Regeneration +{regen}, magnet +{magnet}. At full health it lashes out around you every {counter} s.
skill.coinFever.summary: Raises coin gain and attack speed together.
skill.coinFever.awakening: Picking up coins sends attack speed up {boost}% for {seconds} s.
skill.eclipseStep.summary: When threats close in, cuts through them in a flash of shadow.
skill.eclipseStep.awakening: Slash radius +{radius}. A black afterimage then sweeps the field again for {damage}% damage.
skill.executionMark.summary: Raises critical chance and damage to bosses.
skill.executionMark.awakening: Critical +{crit}%, boss damage +{boss}%. Deals up to {bonus}% extra damage to bosses low on health.
skill.mirrorClone.awakening.classic: With Black Rail, the clones copy a rail {chance}% of the time for {railDamage}% damage. Without the rail it does nothing.
fusion.executionRain.body: Each volley fires 2 more needles, and a needle finishes any enemy (not a boss) it leaves under 15% health.
fusion.frostChain.body: Every jump of the white chain slows like the chalk cut, and its last target is rooted.
fusion.voidMortar.body: A void opens where each bone shell will land and pulls enemies in first.
fusion.mirrorRail.body: Both clones fire every black rail with you.
fusion.eclipseSun.body: Each eclipse step leaves a small black sun where it struck.
fusion.ironWard.body: When you are hit, the enemies the paper armour pushes away take damage and are stunned.
bonus.overdrive.body: Your attack and attack speed upgrades for this run each go up a step at once, until the run ends.
bonus.overdrive.line: Offered when no skill is left to pick
bonus.coins.body: Gain coins at once. The amount grows with the stage and the round.
bonus.heal.body: Restores 15% of your max health at once.
bonus.heal.line: A reward to keep you going
objective.midBoss: Defeat the chapter {chapter} mid-boss · it enrages when time runs out
objective.finalBoss: Defeat the chapter {chapter} boss · it enrages when time runs out
objective.holdLine: hold the line against mid-size foes
objective.infinite: Defeat random bosses back to back
bonus.goal.hold: Hold the marked ground for {n} s
bonus.goal.terrain: Spend at most {n} s in hazards
bonus.goal.fieldBossesWithin: Defeat all {n} field bosses, each within {s} s of its arrival
objective.mod.rangedCap: Up to {n} ranged enemies at once
chapter.name: Chapter {n}: {theme}
chapter.subtitle: 10 stages · St5 mid-boss · St10 chapter boss
game.title: Blackline Survivor
game.noCanvas: This browser cannot show the Canvas play area.
draft.lead: Pick one reward. The fight waits until you do.
draft.hint.next: ★ Its awakening leads the next draft
draft.banish.label: Banish {skill} (this run)
draft.keys.keyboard: Keys 1–{count} pick · arrows move · Enter confirms
settle.damage.label: Damage share by skill
settle.practiceNote: Practice stages unlock nothing and pay 30% of the rewards.
settle.nextFromMenu: Start the next stage from stage select.
hud.summary.infinite: Endless mode, chapter {chapter}. Time {time}. Score {score}. Bosses defeated {bosses}.
hud.summary.health: Health {hp} / {max}. Move with {keys}, the arrow keys, a pointer, or a gamepad.
hud.summary.pause: Pause with P, Escape, or the gamepad Start button.
hud.chapterTurn: The endless fight turns to the next chapter.
pause.title: Paused
pause.lead.keyboard: The run is paused. Continue with P or Escape.
pause.lead.pad: The run is paused. Continue with {pause} or {back}.
pause.healNote: Health added by an upgrade fills in over {seconds} s after you resume.
pause.coinNote: Settlement gold counts the coins you earned this stage, so spending them here costs you nothing.
pause.abandon.infinite: Give up now and the run is recorded and settled exactly as a defeat. Stop here?
pause.abandon.campaign: Give up now and the stage settles exactly as a defeat. Stop here?
controls.menu.keyboard: Arrows · Enter confirms · Escape goes back
controls.skills.keyboard: Every skill fires on its own
controls.skills.pad: Every skill fires on its own
settings.windowMode.note: The next launch opens the same way. On macOS, Ctrl+Cmd+F or the green window button switches it too.
settings.moveKeys.press: Press the key for ‘{action}’. Esc cancels.
settings.moveKeys.refused: {key} has another job and can’t be chosen.
settings.moveKeys.note: The arrow keys always move. P, R, and 1–4 have other jobs and can’t be chosen.
settings.pace.note: Round length applies from the next run.
settings.autoPause: Pause when the window loses focus
settings.assistNote: With assists on, runs stay off the infinite board, and campaign records are marked as assisted.
save.text: Save text (an export, or the text to import)
save.copied: Copied to the clipboard. Paste it somewhere safe, such as a notes app.
save.copyManually: Copy all of the text above and keep it.
save.confirm: This replaces your progress with this save. Press again to import.
save.refuse.format: This is not an exported save. Paste all of it, from start to end.
save.refuse.save: The save is missing or damaged, so nothing was imported. Your data is unchanged.
save.refuse.future: This save comes from a newer version. Update the game, then import it.
save.refuse.storage: Could not save. Your data is unchanged.
fault.title: An error stopped the run
fault.body: An error came up during play, so the game paused itself. Try again to go back to the pause screen. Going to the menu settles this run exactly as a defeat, and it cannot be resumed.
reset.title: Reset your progress?
reset.body: Gold, account level, permanent upgrades, and unlocked stages go back to the start.
hint.move.keyboard: Move with {keys} or the arrow keys. Attacks fire on their own.
hint.move.pad: Move with the {move}. Attacks fire on their own.
hint.xp: Collect the green ink shards to level up and pick skills.
hint.shop: You have coins. Pause with {pause} to buy upgrades.
hint.telegraph: Watch the orange warning the boss draws on the ground, and get out before it fills.
menu.chapterLocked: Clear stage 10 of the previous chapter
infinite.title: Endless
infinite.name: Player name
board.title: Top 10
board.legacy: {count} records from the old rules (v1) are kept apart from the current rules (v{version}) ranking.
board.status.excluded: Cheats or developer mode were used, so this run is not ranked.
board.status.ranked: Made the top 10 on this device.
board.status.saved: Saved the record, but it did not make the top 10.
board.status.noStorage: Browser storage is unavailable, so the record was not saved.
notice.art: Could not load the character art, so plain shapes stand in. Play is not affected.
notice.error: An error came up and was logged. If it keeps happening, copy the log and send it to us.
notice.suspendPaid: The rules changed with this update, so the suspended run cannot go on. It was settled for what it reached: {gold} gold and {xp} account XP.
notice.suspendBroken: The suspended run could not be put back together, so it was settled for what it reached and ended: {gold} gold and {xp} account XP.
notice.saveMove.failed: Your save from the earlier version could not be moved. Restart the game to try again. If you play now, progress goes to a new save, and to keep it, the earlier save will not be moved over it automatically.
notice.saveMove.kept: This save already has progress, so the save from the earlier version was not moved over it. To switch to the earlier save, paste the backup file's text into Settings > Save > Import.
notice.saveMove.unreadable: Your save from the earlier version could not be read, and it can no longer be moved. A raw copy of the earlier data is kept; to get it back, send us that copy.
notice.saveMove.backup: Backup file of the earlier saves: {path}
notice.saveMove.rawCopy: Raw copy of the earlier data: {path}
resume.title: Suspended run
resume.loading: Putting the suspended run back together…
error.copyFailed: The clipboard is unavailable, so the log was not copied.
seed.resultCopied: Copied the result and the challenge seed.
codex.title: Codex
codex.pick: Pick an entry to read about it.
codex.hint.skills: Take this skill in a run to record it.
codex.hint.enemies: Defeat this enemy to record it.
codex.hint.bosses: Defeat this boss to record it.
codex.hint.terrain: Step into this terrain, or make it, to record it.
codex.hint.chapters: Play a stage of this zone to record it.
achievement.goal.noHit: Clear a stage without taking damage
achievement.goal.swift: Beat {n} boss stages before their bosses enrage
achievement.goal.survive: Survive {m} minutes in one endless run
cosmetic.kind.title: Title
star.lowDamage: Clear with less damage than your max health
star.swift: Beat the boss before it enrages
skill.inkDarts.summary: Throws two quick ink darts at the nearest enemy.
skill.brushQuills.summary: Fans out three brush quills that pierce once.
skill.sealArrows.summary: One heavy seal arrow runs through three enemies.
skill.frostNeedles.summary: Two frost needles slow what they hit.
skill.thunderNeedles.summary: Charged needles sometimes stun what they hit.
skill.twinBlades.summary: Throws two blades wide, knocking enemies back.
skill.ghostVolley.summary: Four ghost shots fan out and pierce.
skill.headsmanDarts.summary: Finishes off any ordinary enemy left low.
skill.paperStorm.summary: Scatters eight paper blades in every direction.
skill.inkBloom.summary: Six ink needles bloom outward and slow.
skill.thornHalo.summary: Twelve short thorns stab all around.
skill.starShards.summary: Five star shards fly out and pierce twice.
skill.sunNeedles.summary: Bursts sixteen needles out like the sun.
skill.inkDrizzle.summary: Sprays ink drops toward the nearest enemy.
skill.pinHail.summary: Pours pins out wide and fast.
skill.tailGuard.summary: Throws three knives behind you as you move.
skill.smokeTail.summary: Leaves two smoke needles behind to slow pursuers.
skill.gravePins.summary: Five grave pins fan out behind you.
skill.trackingSeals.summary: Fires one seal at each of the three nearest enemies.
skill.huntersMarks.summary: Aims at four enemies, with a better chance to crit.
skill.crowFeathers.summary: Throws a feather knife at each of the five nearest.
skill.bossbane.summary: Goes for the boss first and hurts bosses more.
skill.inkLightning.summary: Drops ink lightning on two enemies, sometimes stunning.
skill.brushDownpour.summary: Four small brush blots rain on enemies in range.
skill.fallingScroll.summary: A great scroll drops into the thick of the crowd.
skill.seventhSeal.summary: Seven seals burst over enemies all at once.
skill.inkPulse.summary: Bursts an ink pulse around you, knocking enemies back.
skill.frostRing.summary: Freezes the ring around you, slowing it hard.
skill.thunderclap.summary: One clap stuns everything around you.
skill.silenceBell.summary: A wide toll that hits hard and slows.
skill.inkPots.summary: Lobs an ink pot that bursts a moment later.
skill.clusterPots.summary: Three small pots scatter and burst around the target.
skill.tarJar.summary: A sticky jar bursts and slows what it catches.
skill.meteorBrush.summary: A slow but huge brush meteor slams down.
skill.sparkThread.summary: A spark thread hops between three nearby enemies.
skill.stormThread.summary: Hops six times and sometimes stuns.
skill.frostChainlet.summary: Hops four times, slowing all it touches.
skill.inkLance.summary: Thrusts a long ink lance toward the nearest enemy.
skill.wideBrush.summary: Sweeps a broad stroke ahead, knocking enemies back.
skill.crossStrokes.summary: Draws strokes in four directions at once.
skill.judgmentLine.summary: A long judgment line that ends ordinary enemies left low.
skill.inkOrbit.summary: Often sweeps a band around you, wearing down the close.
skill.wardRing.summary: Strikes and pushes back enemies that come close.
skill.eclipseHalo.summary: Sweeps a wide band hard, hitting all within.
skill.inkDarts.awakeningGimmick: Ink stain: a struck enemy keeps a stain for {seconds}s; at {stacks} stains it bursts over {radius} for {damage}% damage.
skill.brushQuills.awakeningGimmick: Late strokes: where a quill first hits bursts {delay}s later over {radius} for {damage}% damage.
skill.sealArrows.awakeningGimmick: Domino: an enemy pushed into another within {seconds}s hurts both for {damage}% and stuns them {stun}s.
skill.frostNeedles.awakeningGimmick: Freeze: a slowed enemy hit {hits} times within {window}s freezes for {freeze}s.
skill.thunderNeedles.awakeningGimmick: Shock leap: hitting a stunned enemy arcs to another within {range} for {damage}% damage.
skill.twinBlades.awakeningGimmick: Spin: at the end of their range the blades spin {seconds}s, cutting {radius} around every {tick}s for {damage}%.
skill.ghostVolley.awakeningGimmick: Haunting: a kill with a ghost arrow sends one more arrow at the nearest enemy.
skill.headsmanDarts.awakeningGimmick: Dread: an execution sends ordinary enemies within {radius} running for {seconds}s.
skill.paperStorm.awakeningGimmick: Whirl: the paper blades curve clockwise as they fly.
skill.inkBloom.awakeningGimmick: Spreading pollen: a struck enemy passes the slow to others within {radius} for {seconds}s.
skill.thornHalo.awakeningGimmick: Thorns: for {seconds}s, a struck enemy takes {damage}% damage for every {step} it moves.
skill.starShards.awakeningGimmick: Ricochet: a shard that hits bounces once to the nearest other enemy within {range}.
skill.sunNeedles.awakeningGimmick: Scorch: needles grow and hit harder the farther they fly (+{damage}% damage and {size}x size at the end).
skill.inkDrizzle.awakeningGimmick: Two streams: sprays alternate between the nearest and the second nearest enemy.
skill.pinHail.awakeningGimmick: Caltrops: where a pin lands, a caltrop stays {seconds}s and deals {damage}% damage to the first enemy on it.
skill.tailGuard.awakeningGimmick: Rear guard: enemies hit behind you within {reach} take {times}x damage.
skill.smokeTail.awakeningGimmick: Smoke: where a needle lands, smoke stays {seconds}s; ordinary enemies in it wander lost for {wander}s.
skill.gravePins.awakeningGimmick: Gravestone: where a pin lands, a gravestone stays {seconds}s and binds the first enemy on it for {root}s.
skill.trackingSeals.awakeningGimmick: Triangle seal: when {seals} seals of one cast pin different enemies, the triangle between them strikes {delay}s later for {damage}% damage.
skill.huntersMarks.awakeningGimmick: Quarry: an enemy you crit takes {prey}% more damage from everything for {seconds}s.
skill.crowFeathers.awakeningGimmick: Crows: a crow circles a struck enemy for {seconds}s, pecking every {tick}s for {damage}% damage.
skill.bossbane.awakeningGimmick: Fracture: every {cracks} hits on a boss burst over {radius} for {damage}% damage.
skill.inkLightning.awakeningGimmick: Lightning pillar: a pillar stands {seconds}s where it strikes and stuns enemies that enter for {stun}s.
skill.brushDownpour.awakeningGimmick: Rising downpour: each mark of a cast lands {growth}% wider than the last.
skill.fallingScroll.awakeningGimmick: Unrolling scroll: the scroll unrolls {length} outward from where it falls for {damage}% damage.
skill.seventhSeal.awakeningGimmick: Eighth seal: one more seal bursts over {radius} in the middle of the seven for {damage}% damage.
skill.inkPulse.awakeningGimmick: Slam: pushes {push}x as far; an enemy pushed into a wall or the edge within {seconds}s is stunned {stun}s.
skill.frostRing.awakeningGimmick: Deep frost: {times}x damage to enemies already slowed.
skill.thunderclap.awakeningGimmick: Echo: {delay}s later an echo {reach}x as wide rings again for {damage}% damage (no stun).
skill.silenceBell.awakeningGimmick: Silence: ordinary enemies the bell reaches cannot ready shots, charges, or blasts for {seconds}s.
skill.inkPots.awakeningGimmick: Burning ink: ink burns {seconds}s where it bursts, dealing {damage}% damage a second to enemies in it.
skill.clusterPots.awakeningGimmick: Split: each pot splits in two that burst again {delay}s later ({damage}% damage).
skill.tarJar.awakeningGimmick: Sticky pull: for {seconds}s, enemies around are pulled to where it burst.
skill.meteorBrush.awakeningGimmick: Star mark: a glowing mark stays {seconds}s where it lands; standing in it, cooldowns run {haste}% faster.
skill.sparkThread.awakeningGimmick: Rewind: the thread runs back from the last enemy to the first for {damage}% damage.
skill.stormThread.awakeningGimmick: Surge: damage grows {damage}% with every jump.
skill.frostChainlet.awakeningGimmick: Bound chain: chained enemies stay linked {seconds}s, each taking {share}% of the damage any of them takes.
skill.inkLance.awakeningGimmick: Forked lance: two branches fork from the lance's tip for {damage}% damage.
skill.wideBrush.awakeningGimmick: Back stroke: {delay}s later it sweeps the other way for {damage}% damage.
skill.crossStrokes.awakeningGimmick: Turning cross: instead of aiming, the cross turns {turn}° each cast.
skill.judgmentLine.awakeningGimmick: Price of judgment: enemies the line executes leave {bounty}x XP and coins.
skill.inkOrbit.awakeningGimmick: Turnback: ordinary enemies' shots that touch the band fly back as yours.
skill.wardRing.awakeningGimmick: Weaken: ordinary enemies the ring hits deal {weaken}% less damage for {seconds}s.
skill.eclipseHalo.awakeningGimmick: Total eclipse: every {every}th sweep fills the band to the middle for {damage}% damage.

character.dan.line: Quick hands that never stop throwing fan knives.
character.noeul.title: Storm Maiden
character.noeul.line: Weaves spark threads that leap between foes.
character.seori.title: Frost Scholar
character.seori.line: A scholar whose frost needles bind pursuing feet.
character.dok.title: Ink Jar Peddler
character.dok.line: A peddler who lobs ink jars into the thick of the crowd.
character.hwi.title: Brush Dancer
character.hwi.line: A dancer who sweeps the way clear with one broad stroke.
character.ryeong.title: Ghost Archer
character.ryeong.line: Brings bosses down with volleys of ghost shots.
character.wol.title: Eclipse Dancer
character.wol.line: Wears the eclipse halo and wears down all that comes near.
